approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would create a new independent federal agency called the Whistleblower Protection Authority to help whistleblowers.

The Authority would provide information, advice, assistance, guidance and support, receive and facilitate investigations of disclosures, investigate mistreatment of whistleblowers, and carry out enforcement and education activities.

The Authority would have jurisdiction over all federal whistleblower protection laws and consist of a Commissioner, Deputy Commissioners, a Chief Executive Officer, and staff, along with an Advisory Board and a Parliamentary Joint Committee.
Establishes the Whistleblower Protection Authority as an independent statutory body.
Gives the Authority powers to receive and facilitate investigations of whistleblower disclosures, provide support, investigate mistreatment, and undertake enforcement and education.
Creates a Whistleblower Protection Advisory Board and a Parliamentary Joint Committee on the Authority.
Whistleblowers and potential whistleblowers under federal whistleblower protection laws.

Moved to restore the Tertiary Education Legislation Amendment (There For Education, Not Profit) Bill 2025, the Remuneration Tribunal Amendment (There For Public Service, Not Profit) Bill 2025 and the Whistleblower Protection Authority Bill 2025 to the Notice Paper, resume second reading consideration and refer them to committees for inquiry and report; each question was agreed to.
